titleStmt.title: Contrastive Pretraining for Natural Language Inference

analytic.title: Contrastive Pretraining for Natural Language Inference

application.desc: GROBID - A machine learning software for extracting information from scholarly documents

p.s: We pretrain a sentence encoder with a contrastive objective and fine-tune it on MNLI, where it reaches 88.0% matched accuracy, 1.9 points above RoBERTa.
Recent work has shown that careful design of the training objective matters as much as model size.
We study this question under a controlled compute budget and report results averaged over several random seeds so that differences can be attributed to the method rather than to noise.
